                      SOAH ORDER NO. 31
      CORRECTING INITIAL LIST OF EXHIBITS TO BE ADMITTED;
      CORRECTING ORDER OF PRESENTATION; AND PROVIDING
     PRELIMINARY LIST OF WITNESSES FOR CROSS-EXAMINATION

I.    EXHIBITS TO BE ADMITTED

      A prehearing conference (PHC) was held in this case on June 5, 2026, via
videoconference. As stated in SOAH Order No. 30, the Administrative Law Judges
(ALJs) intended to admit exhibits filed by the parties via Kiteworks by 5 p.m. on

                                            1

                                  SOAH Order No. 31
                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 June 3, 2026, and that consisted of prefiled testimony or discovery responses.1
Attachment A to SOAH Order No. 30 contained a preliminary list of those exhibits.
However, at the PHC, parties indicated that they had objections or corrections to
Attachment A. Accordingly, the ALJs did not admit the exhibits and instead directed
the parties to file any objections or corrections to Attachment A by noon on
June 7, 2026.


           The ALJs have reviewed the objections and determined that some items
originally listed on Attachment A were not prefiled testimony or discovery
responses. Those items have been removed, and the ALJs provide a Corrected
Attachment A to this Order. The ALJs have also reviewed the proposed corrections,
which consist primarily of proposed additions to the list. These are items that other
parties have not had an opportunity to object to, so the ALJs have added them to a
separate list, Attachment C to this Order.2


           The ALJs intend to admit the exhibits on Corrected Attachment A at the
beginning of the hearing on the merits on June 8, 2026. The ALJs will give the parties
an opportunity to review Attachment C and then will admit those exhibits, subject
to any objections, later in the day on June 8, 2026.




1
    Other exhibits, such as cross-examination or demonstrative exhibits, must be offered separately at the hearing.
2
 The ALJs have designated this attachment as “C” to avoid confusion with “Attachment B,” which is the Intervenor
Order of Presentation that was attached to SOAH Order No. 30 (discussed further below).
                                                            2

                                              SOAH Order No. 31
                                SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 II.      ORDER OF PRESENTATION

         SOAH Order No. 30 also included Attachment B, a preliminary order of
presentation for the hearing. Attachment B assigned each intervenor a party number
and arranged them based on the links they are affected by, as identified by the
Applicants. At the PHC, parties indicated that they had corrections to
Attachment B, and they were directed to file those by noon on June 7, 2026. A
Corrected Attachment B is attached to this Order. As noted at the PHC, the party
number assigned to each intervenor will not change, but the ALJs have corrected the
segments affected and added intervenors to the end of the list if they were initially
omitted.


III. PRELIMINARY LIST OF WITNESSES FOR CROSS-EXAMINATION

         Parties were required to designate their witnesses for cross-examination by
June 3, 2026. The ALJs have prepared a list of witnesses for cross-examination based
on those designations, which is attached as Attachment D to this Order.3 As noted
at the PHC, the ALJs will impose time limits on cross-examination to ensure that all
designated witnesses and parties with questions for those witnesses have an
opportunity to participate. Accordingly, the ALJs will not be honoring statements in
parties’ cross-examination designations that they “reserve the right” to cross any
witness who takes the stand.




3
 Strike-throughs on the list are parties who initially designated a witness for cross-examination but later waived that
witness.
                                                          3

                                            SOAH Order No. 31
                              SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
       As the hearing progresses, parties may determine that they are able to waive
witnesses who they have designated for cross. All waivers should be emailed to
SOAH legal assistant Rhonda Faught at Rhonda.Faught@soah.texas.gov.
